response.text: Now AP vs GL tie-outs, duplicates, and payments.

arguments.sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_DT", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", x.cr2000, x.dr from "APINVH" i left join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "CR_AMT" else 0 end) cr2000, sum("DR_AMT") dr from "GLJRNL" group by 1) x on x."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where x.cr2000<>i."INV_AMT" or x.dr<>i."INV_AMT" or h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" or h."SRC_REF" is distinct from i."INV_NO"

select regexp_replace(upper(trim("INV_NO")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') k, trim("VEND_CD") v, count(*), array_agg("INV_ID"), array_agg("INV_NO"), array_agg("INV_AMT") from "APINVH" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", h."JRNL_NO", x.dr, x.cr, h."POST_DT" from "APPAYM" p left join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" and h."SRC_CD"='AP' left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by 1) x on x."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P' or h."JRNL_NO" is null or x.dr<>p."PAY_AMT" or h."POST_DT"<>p."PAY_DT"
